paper_id: Decision Tree Construction Algorithm Based on Association Rules
title: Decision Tree Construction Algorithm Based on Association Rules
motivation: B2C网站产品信息激增,人工分类费时费力,亟需自动分类技术
problem_framing: 将关联规则挖掘与决策树算法结合,提升文本分类准确率
key_insight: 用关联规则'有效规则'(effective rules)来构建决策树节点
method_signature: 先用Apriori挖掘关联规则,再用有效规则引导决策树分裂
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 关联规则关联过多类别时,无法找到最合适的决策节点,导致某些类别精度很低
evidence_for_taste: how to get a higher accuracy
expect to gain the better result
six of seven categories perform better
cannot find the most proper decision node
the precision of proposal algorithm is very low
thinking_moves: 组合两种经典方法以期获得更好效果
用挖掘出的关联规则来强化决策树属性选择
当有效规则失效时才回退到熵增益方法
